title: finding(tests): a naive-regex TypeScript comment stripper in `ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` survived objectui#9183's census by sharing a file with a YAML one
body:
A naive-regex comment stripper pointed at **TypeScript** — the exact family `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs` declares itself the single answer for — survived the objectui#9183 census by **sharing a file with a YAML stripper**.

## The carrier

`scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts:2133`:

```ts
function withoutTsComments(source: string): string {
  return source.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '').replace(/(^|[^:])\/\/.*$/gm, '$1');
}
```

Pointed at `playwright.live.config.ts`.

## The contract it violates, quoted

`scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs:5`:

> `js-comment-mask -- the ONE answer to "is this span a comment, or code?"`

⇒ a **JavaScript-family** source is being masked by a hand-rolled regex while the declared single answer for that family sits unused in the same repo. ⛔ Unlike the CSS and YAML strippers in the same file, this one is **not** outside the masker's deliberate scope — it is squarely inside it.

## ⭐ Why it escaped the census that was supposed to catch it

objectui#9183 converted the JavaScript family. This site survived **by co-location**: it lives in a file whose *other* stripper is YAML, so a census keyed on "which file has a non-JS stripper" classified the whole file as out of scope. ⭐ That is the reusable half — **a census that classifies by file rather than by site will miss a second site in a mixed file**, and this is a measured instance of it.

⚠️ The irony is on the record: the docblock immediately above the function explains why a whole-file regex is wrong for this input — *"A whole-file regex would read that prose as configuration — the same class of mistake as counting a commented-out `env:` key"* — and then the function is a whole-file regex.

## Reachability — latent, not live

⛔ **Not reachable today**: the file still yields the correct reporter value `[['list']]`. ⇒ same grade as the card it came from; this is a latent-correctness finding, ⛔ not a live defect.

## Provenance

Surfaced by objectui#9323's dev while re-deriving the stripper list from the tree (report `5696300424`). ⭐ **The card counted three carriers; the tree has five sites across four files** — two in one file the card counted once, plus this one, which is in neither the card nor triage's grading. ⛔ Not fixed in PR objectui#9611: triage scoped that card **down** to the JSONC convergence, and this is a different family's subject.
